types.name: Private Company Limited by Shares
types.summary: The most common company type for small and medium enterprises.
types.secretary: The company secretary cannot also be the sole director
types.notes: Can avail of audit exemption and file abridged financial statements if it falls below the audit thresholds.

types.name: Designated Activity Company
types.summary: A private company limited by shares, incorporated to carry out a specific activity.
types.secretary: The company secretary may be one of the directors
types.notes: Can avail of audit exemption and file abridged financial statements if it falls below the audit thresholds.

types.name: Company Limited by Guarantee
types.suffix: Must end in “Company Limited By Guarantee”
types.summary: Has no share capital. Typically used by not-for-profits, representative bodies, sporting and charitable organisations, and owner management companies.
types.secretary: The company secretary may be one of the directors
types.liability: Members have limited liability up to the amount stated in the constitution, usually €1.00
types.notes: Can avail of audit exemption and file abridged financial statements if it falls within the audit thresholds.

types.name: Unlimited Company
types.secretary: The company secretary may be one of the directors
types.liability: The liability of the shareholders is unlimited
types.notes: May avail of audit exemption and may not be required to file financial statements if it falls within the audit thresholds and other criteria.
